paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得在一张陌生标签上停顿，不清楚眼前的数字是编号还是数量；另一段记忆只剩“又看了一遍”。两个描述不必有共同原因，也不因没有具体数字而失去用处。例子不要求找回标签、估算、抄数或比较速度，不把一次停顿扩展为不会处理数字的身份。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls pausing over an unfamiliar label without knowing whether its number was a code or a quantity; another recollection is only looking again. The descriptions need no shared cause and can be useful without exact figures. The scene requires no retrieved label, estimate, copied digits or speed comparison and turns no pause into an identity of being unable to handle numbers.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得不清楚一个数在场景里代表什么；具体数字想保留；想先问单位或含义能否说明。”可以只读虚构卡。听者不出题测试、不判断数感，也不从停顿推断粗心；讨论停在信息需求，不替真实数字作正确性或安全保证。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names uncertainty about what a number meant in context, keeps the figure private and asks whether its unit or meaning can be explained. Read only the fictional card. A listener sets no test, judges no number sense and infers no carelessness from a pause. Discussion stays with the information need and supplies no guarantee about a real figure’s accuracy or safety.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是计算障碍筛查、诊断、算术练习或财务建议。20条仍保留四组各五条的六类记录；计数算描述，不算错误、计算、金额或分钟，未计分不补零。四个可重叠的主题是编辑分组，工具使用与担忧不追加为诊断指标。原观察尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值；四周是编辑回忆时段，不是诊断时长。数值推理练习的题目、答对数与指南保持独立，不合并结果。任何类别不授权改变剂量、付款、出行或安全核对，不替代合适评估及已有专业指示。四篇全文与支持说明无需作答；复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含私人类别、数字或记录。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not dyscalculia screening, diagnosis, arithmetic practice or financial advice. Twenty descriptions retain four six-category records of five. Counts concern descriptions, not errors, calculations, amounts or minutes; unscored is not zero. Four overlapping topics are editorial groupings. Tool use and worry supply no additional diagnostic indicators. The original observations lack independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence; four weeks is an editorial recall window, not a diagnostic duration. Numerical-reasoning questions, correct counts and guides remain separate without combined results. No category authorises changed dosing, payment, travel or safety checks, or replaces appropriate assessment and existing professional instructions. All four guides and support information need no answers. Copying contains only the public title and entry, without private categories, figures or records.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得听讲时觉得明白，后来只凭回忆不知道下一步；另一次保留了示例供查看。两段不需要比较哪次更独立，也不能说明笔记补偿了哪种缺陷。例子不提供计算题，不撤掉示例、不重现错误或规定少核对一次；实际任务背景仍可未知。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls following an explanation but later being unsure of the next step from memory; on another occasion an example remained available. Neither occasion needs an independence ranking or an explanation of which deficit a note compensates for. The scene supplies no calculation, removes no example, recreates no error and prescribes no reduction in checks. Practical context can remain unknown.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡分开“记得在哪一步不清楚”“当时有哪些参照”和“想询问哪些说明”，不必提供真实算式。可以只读。听者不要求心算证明，不把核对视为多余，也不引用另一份执行功能结果解释这次经历；可询问示例是否可保留，不保证特定安排一定可用。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates the remembered unclear step, references available at the time and explanations worth asking about, without a real calculation. Reading alone is enough. A listener requires no mental-arithmetic demonstration, treats no check as unnecessary and uses no separate executive-function result to explain the occasion. A question can concern keeping an example available without promising a particular arrangement.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得面对不熟悉时间格式时停顿，另一项任务的实际时长又与计划不同，却不知道是否涉及相同背景。格式理解与计划差异可以分开，不能合成时间感或空间能力结论。例子不要求看钟、计时、换算、重走路线或移除日历提醒，也不给真实出行作安全裁定。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls pausing over an unfamiliar time format and a separate task taking longer than planned, without knowing whether the circumstances were related. Format interpretation and a planning mismatch remain separate and establish no time-sense or spatial-ability conclusion. The scene requires no clock reading, timing, conversion, repeated journey or removed calendar reminder and gives no safety verdict for travel.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想分别谈时间格式与任务安排中的不清楚；还不知道原因；具体地点和行程想保留。”可以只读。听者不测试方向、不规定更准确估时，也不把提醒当作不独立；可以询问格式、单位或下一步能否说明更清楚，已有安全核对仍独立保留。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card keeps uncertainty about a time format separate from task planning, leaves causes unknown and keeps locations and journeys private. It can remain reading only. A listener tests no directions, prescribes no more accurate estimate and treats no reminder as lack of independence. Questions can concern clearer formats, units or next steps while established safety checks remain independent.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得两种价格展示难比较，又记得曾借助说明理解一项百分比，但不想提供金额或交易内容。这些只描述信息需要，不证明预算问题、财务能力或计算障碍。例子不包含优惠选择、付款建议或计算任务，不要求查账单、重复交易或展示损失。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls difficulty comparing two price displays and using an explanation to understand a percentage, while keeping amounts and transaction details private. These describe information needs rather than a budget problem, financial capacity or dyscalculia. The scene includes no offer selection, payment advice or calculation task and requires no statement review, repeated transaction or demonstrated loss.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“有些金额信息我想听更清楚的说明；数字与账户细节不分享；现在只想了解可以怎样提问。”可以只读。听者不替人决定支付、借款或接管财务，不要求账单作为困难证明，也不把求助等同无能力。交流卡不验证任何人、服务或真实交易。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card asks for a clearer explanation of amount-related information, keeps figures and account details private and focuses only on how to ask. Read without a personal account. A listener decides no payment or borrowing, takes over no finances, requests no statement as proof and equates no assistance with incapacity. The card verifies no person, service or real transaction.
